_comment: Pins that DIFFER from the wiki on purpose, with the reason. Same idea as
quest-granted-reviewed.json: without a place to record 'looked at this,
it is correct', an audit re-reports every settled decision forever and
Add an entry only when you can say WHY ours is better. 'Looks fine' is
not a reason - leave it flagged.

reviewed.zmi bank: Surface entrance of the Ourania Cave. Shortest Path cannot draw a route into a cave interior, so interiors are anchored at the way in (wave 5).
reviewed.karamja: Musa Point, not the jungle. The wiki pin at 2843,3070 is ~120 tiles from any landing and the step ticked in the field (wave 12).
reviewed.ardy general store: Hand-corrected to Aemad's after audit-shops found the town-page pin was a random landmark (wave 6).
